sections.heading: Rallying a raid
sections.body: Raid bosses are permanent regional encounters. Create a public raid for free, or join an existing muster. A character can participate in only one active raid at a time, and each account can occupy only one place in a raid.

sections.heading: The three wings
sections.body: The raid leader assigns every participant to Vanguard, Flank, or Ward before commencing. Flank reduces the reinforcements that reach the boss. Ward tears down the boss's protection. Vanguard confronts the boss under the conditions created by the other two wings.

sections.heading: Resolution and rewards
sections.body: After commencement the three battles resolve in the background from the saved character snapshots. Return to the raid page to see the outcome and claim trophies and materials. Your first reward from a particular raid boss each week is the full payout; later completions pay a reduced amount.
